stem:
The marks scored by 50 students in a class test are grouped as follows:

Class interval: 10-20, frequency 4
Class interval: 20-30, frequency 8
Class interval: 30-40, frequency 15
Class interval: 40-50, frequency 13
Class interval: 50-60, frequency 7
Class interval: 60-70, frequency 3

Using the formula Mode = L + (f1 - f0) / (2*f1 - f0 - f2) * h, what is the modal class and the mode?

per_option_rationale.rationale: A student who misidentifies the modal class as 40-50 (second highest) computes L=40, f1=13, f0=15, f2=7: Mode = 40 + (13-15)/(26-15-7)*10 = 40 + (-2/4)*10 = 40 - 5 = 35, but may further miscalculate; taking 40-50 as modal and plugging f0=8 (from 20-30) gives 40 + (13-8)/(26-8-7)*10 = 40 + 50/11 = 43.33.
Reporting the upper boundary of the modal class (40) instead of computing the mode formula; a student confuses modal class boundary with the mode value.

Using wrong denominator: 2*15-8-13 = 9, but a slip gives denominator 2*15-8 = 22, so Mode = 30 + 7/22*10 = 30 + 3.18 or rounding error; alternatively f0 taken as 4 (first class) gives 30 + (15-4)/(30-4-13)*10 = 30 + 110/13 = 38.46; taking denominator as (f1-f0)=7 and h=10 but computing L+h*(f1-f0)/f1 = 30 + 10*(7/15) = 34.67, truncated to 34.

explanation: The modal class is 30-40 (frequency 15 is the maximum). Applying the interpolation formula with L=30, f1=15, f0=8 (preceding class), f2=13 (following class), h=10: Mode = 30 + (15-8)/(2*15-8-13) * 10 = 30 + 7/9 * 10 = 30 + 7.78 = 36.67 (rounded to 2 decimal places, exact = 30 + 70/9).

explanation_sections.punchline: The insight is identifying f0 and f2 as the frequencies of the classes immediately before and after the modal class, not any other classes.
explanation_sections.approach: Formula selection for grouped mode: (1) Identify modal class = class with highest frequency. (2) Label L = lower boundary, f1 = modal frequency, f0 = preceding frequency, f2 = following frequency, h = class width. (3) Apply Mode = L + (f1-f0)/(2*f1-f0-f2) * h. Map givens: L=30, f1=15, f0=8, f2=13, h=10.
explanation_sections.lesson: For grouped data, the mode lies inside the modal class; f0 and f2 are always the frequencies of the adjacent classes, not the extremes.
explanation_sections.timing: About 75 seconds. Spot-check: denominator = 2*15-8-13 = 9 > 0, confirming the modal class is correct. If denominator comes out negative, you have picked the wrong modal class.
